test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of:: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

#: MTZ :: KRX: %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : MTZ :: KRX : %

**Option 1) # = HOU, % = PWP**

**For # (HOU) to MTZ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/196cdd1c75e82707c5853e4a7d982529c2052f18aae955dee748138d4bd36105.png] 

**For KRX to % (PWP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9bdad20c6179a9752a5983430f08a5dd52107ba492127679ebaec6a9168183d.png] 

Option 1 is incorrect.

**Option 2) # = HYU, % = PWC**

**For # (HYU) to MTZ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26f9335592a11acfc10f844641b3c0487c6dacb276a232aa37f2b7b52931c800.png] 

**For KRX to % (PWC)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f07de582368a47f25ece431ebc5b344d37a6a79bfb3a705308de76d361d3a6c.png] 

Option 2 is incorrect.

**Option 3) # = YOU, % = PWC**

**For # (YOU) to MTZ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab71d4b63c1a87324a64930cdb30a866a7e6767665f5bd46b9ef587073eca42e.png] 

**For KRX to % (PWC)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f6379d325e3aa2a7ea8bf159af667d570e4ba0e35a121900fba59d4a275c920.png] 

Option 3 is incorrect.

**Option 4) # = HOU, % = PWC**

**For # (HOU) to MTZ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66a6da5a5cfc9a5809a9fcea294f87df6f0ef32f792ef7471afd648fc42b25d8.png] 

**For KRX to % (PWC)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2d87fe7a3858532b9bdbbbcc6b8c05153df7a3bb4ecb2a85d14ae87f39e0985.png] 

Option 4 is correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
